info.title: BelGomla API
info.description: Every tenant lives on its own host ({tenant}.gomalecommerce.app); the host decides the tenant, never a header or payload. Auth is a Sanctum SPA cookie session: GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie first, then send the XSRF-TOKEN cookie back as the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. All text is Arabic, dates are ISO-8601 UTC and money is a "150.00" string.

Sets the manual discounts of a pending or confirmed order, per line and on the whole order (BR-PR08, D85)
put.description: The body is the whole discount state: a line left out of `items`, or a null `order`, has no discount. Owners and managers give any discount; a sales user gives line discounts only, each at most `max_discount_percent_sales` % off the list price (null = none). The history gets the note «خصم»; `order.discount_changed` is audited.

409.description: order_locked (preparing or later) or below_collected (the new total is under what was collected)

422.description: discount_too_large (a unit or the order below 0.01) or validation_failed

put.summary: Changes the lines of a pending or confirmed order (BR-O12, D87)
put.description: The body is every line the order should have: an existing line by its `order_item_id` (same SKU), a new one without. A live line left out is removed (kept for history), a quantity change re-prices the line at the current tiers keeping its manual discount, a new line is priced like checkout; unchanged lines keep their snapshot. Stock is checked like checkout with what the order holds counted as available. The history gets «تعديل الطلب», `order.lines_changed` is audited and the customer gets the `edited` text when the store notifies it.

422.description: checkout_failed (items for the added or changed lines; details.credit when a higher total passes the credit limit); discount_too_large when an EGP order discount no longer fits; validation_failed (also lines.N.order_item_id not a live line of the order, lines.N.sku_id changed or not this store's)

lines.description: Each SKU unit once (D91; one SKU may come in two units); quantity in that unit

address_id.description: One of the customer's active addresses

note.description: Kept as the order note; the customer sees it

override_mov.description: D84 waive the minimum order value for this order; needs orders.override_mov

lines.description: As in the quote, plus an optional discount per line (D85; needs orders.discount)

discount.description: D85 the order discount, applied after the checks at list prices; needs orders.discount and a reason

problem.description: The checkout_failed entry of this line without sku_id and sku_unit_id, or null

credit.description: BR-C05 set when the order would pass the credit limit

converted_from.description: The pre-order number this order was converted from (BR-O14)

conversions.description: The normal orders a pre-order was converted into, oldest first

OrderReturn.description: A return (BR-R01..R06). `order` (the balance after the change) is on the list and the writes, not inside the order detail; `customer` on the list only.

unit_price.description: What one unit returns at: the line price less the order discount share (D85)

delivered.description: What went out (BR-O13); returnable = delivered − returned

StoreOrderReturn.description: A live return as the customer sees it (BR-R05), without the merchant's reason

OrderMessage.description: A WhatsApp/SMS message sent about the order (BR-N03), fallbacks included, oldest first

details.description: Orders: order_number, customer_name, order_total (+ reason when customer_cancelled); whatsapp_dropped: phone, reason

kind.description: A refund pays back part of a return (BR-R04) and lowers the collected amount

order_return_id.description: The return a refund belongs to

customer_credit_id.description: BR-C07: the credit a credit collection draws from (payment) or creates (refund)

LedgerRow.description: One statement row (BR-C08). Positive balance = the customer owes the store.

available_credit.description: credit_limit − exposure (D77); null without a limit

total.description: Placed today, not cancelled, minus today's live returns (BR-R05)

aging.description: The outstanding by days past due (BR-C06): not due yet, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, over 90
